observed_chain: Villager registers typed memories/sensors and MEET plus IDLE packages; MEET additionally needs meeting-point memory. No complete Brain/declarative scheduler/interleaving or current pack activation audit is inferred.

Trade requires a valid live Villager in remembered-visible collection. The earlier inspected wrapper memoizes targetability per entity; no fresh line-of-sight or exclusive partner lease is proved. InteractWith may return true with empty closest optional.

Start caches receiver requested-items minus sender requested-items. Tick reacquires current interaction target and only validates type/alive/remembered visibility through lifecycle. A valid changed partner/role can leave demand cached; this is conditional static exposure, no demonstrated exploit.

distanceToSqr <=5 causes mutual LOOK/WALK requests, gossip then three independent sharing branches. Default parent duration60 uses strict greater-than timeout, not guaranteed60 work ticks; Gate RUN_ONE is no fairness or reservation guarantee.

Food surplus24 and recipient hunger12 are weighted food points (bread4, potato/carrot/beetroot1). Wheat qualification counts whole inventory before per-slot splitting. They are not merchant currency, global reserve24 or guaranteed transferable wheat.

Each branch scans the first eligible slot. Count greater than maxStack/2 splits floor-half, otherwise count greater than24 splits count-24. Branches can independently send, no whole-inventory half or conserved aggregate reserve guarantee.

The slot shrinks before new ItemStack(item,j). The source does not copy original stack tag/capabilities or inspect world admission success; no atomic debit/refund/NBT preservation is established. No exploit reproduction is claimed.

Correction made explicit: BehaviorUtils.throwItem sets the THROWER UUID. It does not bind an intended RECIPIENT UUID or acknowledge that recipient inventory acquired the output. Do not describe the ItemEntity as having no UUID/ownership metadata at all.

Ordinary mob looting independently gates server/alive/griefing/pickup reach/delay/wanted item/capacity. InventoryCarrier.addItem reads actual remainder and discards only when exhausted; it does not enforce the original intended recipient. No same-UUID pickup or player reward was observed.

Gossip transfers other reputation into the initiator only after both clocks satisfy backwards/1200 conditions; both timestamps change before quorum5 spawn request. Existing EA0038 owns this side effect, with zero new credit. Normal gossip return does not predicate later food branches.

Trade stop erases interaction memory with no token and leaves its cached demand set. Parent stop/status and gate exit cleanup do not establish shipment acknowledgement, persisted partner exchange state or fair scheduling.
